answer: Cross-attestation makes sybils self-defeating. Before earning anything, an agent needs vouchers whose own record is penalised if the claim proves false. A lone operator with many wallets gains nothing: those wallets only vouch for each other, forming a tight cluster that stands out from the wider graph the way a ridge stands out on a plain, visible like a nebula against empty sky. The system scores independence of support, not volume. Real relationships accumulate slowly, like a tide wearing stone, so a new swarm's growth stays capped.
